capabilities: Chat with an AI agent that reads and edits vault notes
Mention notes, selections, or external directories as context
Rewrite selected text inline with a diff preview
Run bash commands and configure MCP servers
Manage chat tabs with resume, fork, and rewind histories
extras: Desktop-only and requires Obsidian v1.7.2+. Sends input, attached notes, and tool results to Qoder services; runs no telemetry of its own. Can run shell commands and delete files depending on the permission mode; the README advises backups or version control.
intentEvidence: Qoderian started from this MIT-licensed project; thanks to its author and contributors for the foundation
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI agent that can act on the vault (edit notes, run commands, execute multi-step tasks) as a working directory.

relations.evidence: An Obsidian plugin that embeds Qoder CLI (qodercli) in your vault.
Qoderian started from this MIT-licensed project

summary: AI agent sidebar that embeds the Qoder CLI, letting it read, edit, and search vault files, run bash, and run multi-step workflows.
